node.name: Set shield
node.description: A steady guard covers the bearer while facing the incoming line. Lower-dan techniques remain the lower-commitment option.

deepening.explanation: Establishes ordinary directional protection as the low-commitment option.

node.name: Aikido Protection dan 1
node.description: Low-level use: a low-cost flow response that is unavailable without a committed incoming action. Zodiac direction: answer a threat with path-specific defense and response.

deepening.explanation: Foundation exposes a low-cost flow response that is unavailable without a committed incoming action without promising the branch's advanced mechanisms.

node.name: Affinity Reading: Condition
node.description: reading only delivered and permitted evidence. The earlier techniques remain independently selectable; this dan does not silently replace them.

deepening.explanation: reading only delivered and permitted evidence; it deepens a bounded reveal of fire resistance without removing that lower-cost use.

node.name: First loose
node.description: A simple arrow is loosed before a longer aiming exchange develops. Lower-dan techniques remain the lower-commitment option.

deepening.explanation: Establishes the ordinary projectile shot as the low-preparation option.

node.name: Side-Step Image
node.description: Projects one short-lived visual sensor image beside the caster to cover a withdrawal without creating a combat actor.

deepening.explanation: Establishes the inexpensive single visual decoy; it never gains collision, HP, damage or victory eligibility.

node.name: Scout Rat
node.description: Creates one fragile, short-lived scout that spends upkeep and autonomously harasses a recorded legally observed hostile for low damage.

deepening.explanation: Establishes bounded autonomous scouting with a single use, finite lifetime and upkeep; recorded policy decisions are not external redirect instructions, and it has no drain or victory eligibility.

node.name: Elemental Balance: Foundation
node.description: a self-applied water interaction. The earlier techniques remain independently selectable; this dan does not silently replace them.

deepening.explanation: a self-applied water interaction; it deepens a self-applied water interaction without removing that lower-cost use.

node.name: Flame Pressure: Condition
node.description: ignition admitted only on a valid hit. The earlier techniques remain independently selectable; this dan does not silently replace them.

deepening.explanation: ignition admitted only on a valid hit; it deepens a direct fire projectile without removing that lower-cost use.
